text:
sarah: Quick follow-up from last night's latency incident — want to lock owners & timelines for the remediation orchestra. Can folks confirm scope?

ajay: summary pls? I skimmed postmortem but need concrete action list.

sarah: tl;dr p95 hit 420ms for /generate, recurring spikes ~every 3h. Error budget burned ~60% in 12h. New hypothesis: KV cache ineff under tail + autoscaler cooldown.

maria: confirmed. I opened a tracking ticket INF-842. Proposed actions: 1) add per-route p95 dashboard, 2) tweak autoscaler cooldown to 60s, 3) prefix KV cache warmers, 4) run load replay to validate. Need owners.

lee: I'll own dashboard work (per-route metrics + alert). ETA EOD Wednesday. Will add baseline queries and historical 7d comparison.

devon: I'll take autoscaler tuning + load replay. Need to pair with ajay for infra creds. Target end of week.

ajay: pairing ok. Also propose to adjust SLO temporarily: p95 from 150ms -> 200ms for /generate for 2 weeks and notify customers via status page. Thoughts?

sarah: we should avoid SLO drift unless necessary, but error budget is burning. Vote: short window SLO relaxation + stricter alerting. @ops-bot can we schedule a status-page update draft?

ops-bot: status update draft posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INF-842-draft :thumbsup: (react to approve)

lee: approved. I'll hook new dashboard to alert to notify on sustained p95 > 180ms for 30m.

maria: added owners in INF-842: dashboard=lee, autoscale=devon, investigation=ajay, rollback-playbook=sarah. Timeline: dashboards Wed EOD, autoscale tuning Fri EOD, replay Thu. I'll add followup meeting Thurs 10am PT.

sarah: thanks. Quick note on recurring pattern: add a recurring runbook item to check KV cache hit rates every 24h, owner rotation monthly. Can we add to runbook?

lee: added runbook entry in docs repo and will point link in the ticket.

ajay: tagging this as "action-orchestra" for clarity. Will do a short postmortem blurb for ops-retro channel.

devon: starting autoscaler experiment now, will log configs here. Will post results.

sarah: perfect. next check-in Fri 9am PT. thanks all :rocket:
